title: Stalker Ex Stops At Nothing To Hunt Down Ex-Wife: Cops
description:
A Florida man is accused of stalking his ex-wife for years by standing outside her home with binoculars and following her to a gas station, bragging that he can "always find" her vehicle. Watch the arrest of 59-year-old Michael Deardorff unfold on Law&Crime BodyCam.
